_readme: Redacted shape of the AION portal's Google OAuth *web* client (a SEPARATE client from the installed-app Calendar/Gmail one). Download the real JSON from Google Cloud console → Credentials → the 'AION portal' web client, and place it — never committed — at <dataDir>/portals/aion-portal-oauth.json (or point AION_PORTAL_OAUTH_CLIENT at it). The redirect_uris below must exactly match the URIs registered on the client.
